note: Calibrated from a real Serum 2 editor, Init patch. ENV was captured via the Mosh host (Mosh --demo3 → screencapture the 'Serum 2' window); OSC A + FILTER were calibrated from a full-res Ableton-hosted capture and converted into this same Mosh-window reference space (the two windows differ only by a ~25px title-bar offset: same x, Mosh cy = Ableton cy + 25). Coords are in the reference_size pixel space; load_profile() scales them to the actual frame. Knobs read via the blue_tick reader: Serum marks each value with a saturated BLUE tick at the rim (robust on Serum 2's glossy skin, where the white-pointer read is dragged toward 0.5 by the bright top-bevel highlight; falls back to the white pointer on non-default skins). ENV 1 has no DELAY knob (unlike Vital): ATK/HOLD/DEC/SUS/REL.
_controls_note: ENV 1 ADSR + OSC A + FILTER 1. UNISON is a number box (voices), not a knob; PHASE/RAND are tiny header value-displays — both omitted. OSC A has DUAL warp (warp1/warp2). Filter is a 2x3 knob grid (CUTOFF/RES/PAN over DRIVE/FAT/MIX) plus a vertical LEVEL slider (sliders aren't read by the knob reader). The blue_tick reader records each knob's normalized POSITION [0,1].
